title: Hold a debt collector (field or collection agent) licence
what: Be licensed as a field agent or collection agent before collecting debts or doing other regulated activities for reward.

laws.title: Debt Collectors (Field Agents and Collection Agents) Act 2014 (Qld)

sources.title: Debt Collectors (Field Agents and Collection Agents) Act 2014 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not, as an agent for someone else for reward, perform a regulated activity unless the person is authorised under this or another Act to perform the activity.

sources.title: Debt Collectors (Field Agents and Collection Agents) Act 2014 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not act as a debt collector unless the person is authorised under this or another Act to perform activities of a debt collector.
